0022600202.text: Miami (3-6, ninth in the East and three games back in third place in the Southeast) is on a one-game losing streak and has gone 2-3 on the road, while Sacramento (1-8, 15th in the West) has lost two straight and is 0-4 at home. Ben Simmons (Achilles, surgery) and Maxime Raynaud (knee, dislocated) are both out for the Kings. The teams split their 2025-26 season series 1-1, with the Heat winning the last meeting 130-117 in Sacramento on January 20, 2026, and they have not played each other yet in 2026-27.
